xtrm-pc7hs.description:
DESCRIPTION

PROBLEM: Detect/export/import/verify/receipt/cleanup pipeline; fleet sweep  
  removes Beads machinery from managed repos; historical docs may retain      
  references, runtime may not.                                                
                                                                              
  SUCCESS: Acceptance criteria in the cited ADR sections hold on merged main  
  with live evidence.                                                         
                                                                              
  SCOPE: Cited ADR sections; xtrm repo unless the section names               
  core/specialists.                                                           
                                                                              
  NON_GOALS: Neighbor phase scope.                                            
                                                                              
  CONSTRAINTS: Epic constraints apply (one-way, no safety loss, generators-   
  first).                                                                     
                                                                              
  VALIDATION: Live/real-environment evidence per section gates, not static    
  checks alone.                                                               
                                                                              
  OUTPUT: Fix PR(s) merged.                                                   
                                                                              
  SCRUTINY: High.

INTERFACE CONTRACT (core-lane A8 consumer, confirmed 2026-09-10):
- sb import beads --file <export> is one-way, emits receipt with counts + alias map, nonzero on verification failure. Receipt schema is THIS bead's to define (migration pipeline owns it).
- Post-import count/relationship verification uses sb issue read surfaces (verbs TBD by implementer, document the chosen set).
- sb project create-or-resolve + link-checkout names are CONFIRMED existing: project create / project link (plus list/unlink); A9 documents them for the pipeline.

Cross-repo ownership: This core bead mirrors only the core-owned implementation/evidence slice of authoritative xtrm bead xtrm-6qu.9. It must not edit A8-owned files before A8 merges and must report PR/evidence back to xtrm-6qu.9.

SCRUTINY: HIGH.

Coordinator directive received 2026-09-11: inventory-only until A8 lands. Dispatched native explorer act:8582e174-a29 (bead xtrm-maxef) for Beads-machinery inventory, no mutations.

Verified live: policies/beads.json + session-flow.json exist; compile-policies.mjs exists; hooks.json has 8 beads hits; Pi beads ext exists; .xtrm/hooks/beads-edit-gate.mjs exists; fleet-sweep/generated-policy zero hits confirmed by repo grep. Runtime vs docs split confirmed. Cutover plan staged for post-A8. No mutations made.
Coordinator 2026-09-11T01:27Z: inventory accepted/linked. HOLD all edits until A8 merge. Added constraints: (1) preserve worktree-reap behavior when pruning Beads-adjacent session-flow entries; (2) post-A8 PR must touch canonical policies/generator sources + regenerate hooks.json (never hand-edit); (3) remove required Beads extension/registry/cache consumers only after Substrate replacement exists; (4) PR evidence must include live fresh-HOME init/doctor/update + fleet no-beads-active proof.
Coordinator 2026-09-11T01:42Z: A6 merged e91ba4c; A8 lane in final wiring. Hold on A8-owned files continues. Worktree confirmed ready to fetch/rebase on A8 core-PR merge signal.
Coordinator 2026-09-11T02:09Z: A4 staged canonical skill docs (xtrm d764216, A8-first contract). Dispatched native explorer act:2d405a78-358 (bead xtrm-d02zj) for A4-to-core receiving-surface map (registry/install/config/generated/gates), READ_ONLY, fenced. xtrm-side artifacts (A4 source list, section-37 gate text) flagged as must-come-from-coordinator.
A4-to-core map complete (act:2d405a78-358, bead xtrm-d02zj, verified live). 5 channels: R registry copy loop (gen-registry.mjs -> registry.json -> installFromRegistry, drift.ts sha256, pruneRetiredManagedSkills); S specialists-vendored (specialists-source.json pin + vendor-scripts + skills-ownership.json); P policies compile (compile-policies.mjs --check/--check-pi); E pi-extensions (NOT registry-managed, global-only); V runtime views/gates (doctor drift states, check:* suite). Generated-vs-authored split confirmed; ownership rule docs/skills-ownership.md:82-84. Gaps: G1 skills/ vs .xtrm/skills/ authorship unresolved; G2 section-37 text missing in-tree; G3 A4 source list unknowable from core; G4 specialists upstream outside fence; G5 release.json unread. No mutations.
Coordinator ruling 2026-09-11T02:13Z: G1 RESOLVED — core canonical skill sources are .xtrm/skills/default/<skill>/SKILL.md; never skills/, registry outputs, active/, installed trees. A4 d764216 = normative semantic specs only (docs/substrate/skills/{using-xtrm,planning,starting-and-resuming-work}.md + skill-migration-gate.md), not runtime canonical source. Sequence: execute after A8 then A4/A5 merge — implement doctrine in core canonical files, generate registry, run section-37 + ownership/parity gates. Board deps .4->.8, .9->.5 noted. FENCED through A5.
Contract delta 2026-09-11T02:17Z: A8 lands xt-update legacy path FAIL-CLOSED + INACTIVE. A9 (this slice) owns completing/activating it post-A5. Activation bar: exact issue/alias/hierarchy/dependency/note/receipt verification + idempotent rerun proof. bd-export embedded dependencies/notes/comments are authoritative; any runtime dep-query failure must be loud, never silent. Post-A5 plan updated accordingly.
Export-schema proof 2026-09-11T02:18Z, confirmed live via bd export --help: JSONL, one complete issue object per line incl. labels, dependencies, comments. A9 verification parses the durable export itself — no per-ID bd dep list reliance, no live board queries for edge count / note-comment intake reconciliation. Notes/comments intake reconciled from export lines.
Host constraint 2026-09-11T03:46Z: /tmp tmpfs capacity-constrained. All migration/test scratch uses TMPDIR=/var/tmp + /var/tmp; clean only own mktemp dirs.
Cleanup ownership 2026-09-11T13:21Z: A8 exact-allowlists 12 inert retired .xtrm/hooks/beads-* sources + exact test post-registry-removal (temporary). A9 must DELETE or explicitly adjudicate each before section-59; forbidden: restoring registry entries, wildcard allowlists. Matches explorer count: 10 beads-*.mjs + test + companions adjudicated individually.
Sibling lane 2026-09-11T18:31Z: PR #646 (xtrm-2lxah, docs-only) rebased on main, head c95d6ee2, OPEN/MERGEABLE, CI pending, awaiting owner review. No action for pc7hs; main-head noted for post-A5 rebase planning.
GO 2026-09-11T21:02Z: rebased xt/6qu9-core onto origin/main f949b33 (A8 enrollment contract present: substrate.ts 564L + substrate-migration.ts 98L, fail-closed legacy detection, no A9 behavior). Dispatched native executor act:cd7f0800-fc3 (bead xtrm-a2oup) for A9 preservation verifier (issue/alias/hierarchy/dep/note reconciliation + idempotency, export-parse-only). PR HELD until xtrm-6qu.5 + .8.1 security fix. TMPDIR=/var/tmp.
A9 verifier landed (worker act:cd7f0800-fc3, bead xtrm-a2oup). Commit b89f443e on lane xt/6qu9-core (pushed, NO PR per HOLD).

FILES (new-file scope, no existing-symbol edits):
- cli/src/core/substrate-verify.ts (parse + verify + bulk collect, fail-closed, never writes markers/board)
- cli/src/tests/substrate-verify.test.ts (20 tests)

TESTS: new 20/20 pass. Suite totals: substrate.test.ts 31 + substrate-migration.test.ts 6 + substrate-doctrine.test.ts 1 + substrate-verify.test.ts 20 = 58/58 green. cli typecheck clean. Doctrine anti-regression green.

LIVE EVIDENCE (/var/tmp/xt-a9-evidence-dz10Fn, SUBSTRATE_DB=state.db, sb 0.1.0):
- Full bd export: 2278 issues / 1846 embedded dependencies[] edges / 902 issues-with-notes / 17 comments.
- SubsetA PASS (closed dep set, no notes): 4 issues, 7/7 edges, 0/0 notes+comments reconciled; ok:true exit 0; rerun byte-identical (sha256 22b4e928...), exit 0.
- SubsetB FAIL-CLOSED (closed dep set, 7 notes): 7/7 aliases, 8/8 edges exact, notes 7 vs 0 -> ok:false exit 1, sole error 'notes mismatch: export 7 vs substrate 0'; rerun diff-empty, exit 1.
- Import rerun (A): created 0 / skipped 4, exit 0 (issue intake idempotent).
- RESIDUAL sb finding (out of verifier scope, flagged): import rerun re-applies non-parent edges via addEdge, prj_va edges 7->14 rows; verifier flags such extras fail-closed. Notes/comments have no sb intake and no bulk journal surface (per-ref journal excluded by no-per-ID rule).

INTERFACE ASSUMPTIONS for xtrm-side .9.1 receipt lane: (1) canonical receipt schema is yours; PreservationResult is local output, not the receipt; (2) read surfaces used: bulk 'sb export project --project <id> --json' ONLY, no per-ID issue/journal verbs, no bd dep queries; (3) substrate notes/comments default 0 until a bulk intake surface exists; (4) edge kind/orientation mapping mirrors sb 0.1.0 import.ts exactly (parent-child->parent_child B->A, blocks B->A, discovered-from/supersedes direct, relates-to/validates/unknown->relates_to A->B); (5) 'sb project create --prefix / project link' names confirmed existing (evidence setup only).
Executor done (act:cd7f0800-fc3): b89f443e, 2 new files, 20/20 new tests coordinator-verified live, 58/58 suite + typecheck per report, live pass/fail-closed + idempotent reruns in /var/tmp scratch. Seconder dispatched act:5dff986b-68c (bead xtrm-7l4uf). PR still HELD (await xtrm-6qu.5 + .8.1 fix).
Seconder PASS/PASS (act:5dff986b-68c): scope+quality verified file:line; coordinator-owed 20/20 run already done live. Reviewer dispatched act:d8f0bb0a-08e (bead xtrm-34o75). PR still HELD.
GATES COMPLETE 2026-09-11: seconder PASS/PASS, reviewer PASS 9/10 no-fix-loop, coordinator live re-runs: 20/20 new + 58/58 substrate suite (31+6+1+20 across 4 files). Scope: 2 new files, 680 insertions, 0 deletions, A8 untouched, no CLI wiring, no writes. Live evidence: 2278-issue export, pass exit-0 byte-identical rerun + fail-closed notes-mismatch exit-1 diff-empty rerun. PR HELD per order (await xtrm-6qu.5 + .8.1 fix).
Handoff 2026-09-11T21:27Z: .8 + .8.1 closed, main 9e3d78dd green. Lane rebased (b89f443e -> 4235ae5c, clean), 58/58 substrate suite re-verified live on new base. PR still HELD for .5 merge. Fully ready.
PR OPENED 2026-09-12: core PR #649, head 4235ae5c44c799e6e0a455123052c5a66c654499 (lane xt/6qu9-core on main 9e3d78dd). 58/58 re-verified pre-PR. No merge until independent review.
PR #649 dist rebuild (executor xtrm-8hhns): new lane head 7336eaa065d50f4aa1f26df968771f3323fed042 (stacked chore(dist) on 4235ae5c, pushed force-with-lease to xt/6qu9-core). cli/dist regenerated via repo-canonical build; exact CI dist check green locally; 58/58 substrate suite green; verifier files untouched. Relay to epic coordinator.
MERGED 2026-09-12: core PR #649 at 124dd06 (tree-identical to reviewed 7336eaa). Review PASS + 2 notes: (1) bundled statusline change accepted as tested/documented exception; (2) INTERFACE FLAG for .10 acceptance — core verifier fails closed on exports WITH notes/comments by design, xtrm .9.1 imports notes to journal; gap must be covered by bulk notes surface or explicit deferral, to confirm with xtrm lanes at .10.
